packageRules.description: Nothing automerges. A merge to main publishes an image, and main has no required status checks, so GitHub's auto-merge would land a PR before CI had run on it.
One weekly PR for minor and patch Go module bumps instead of one per golang.org/x module. Majors stay separate: they change import paths and need reading.

This is an application, not a library, so the go directive is the toolchain: setup-go reads it via go-version-file. Bump it like any other pin, in the same PR as the golang builder image in the Dockerfile, so CI and the published image build with the same Go.
CI's Postgres matches the production cluster's major, and scripts/devdb.sh's image follows CI. A new major moves deliberately with the cluster, not on Renovate's schedule.

customManagers.description: Tool versions in workflow `with:` blocks, annotated with a `# renovate: datasource=... depName=...` comment on the line above. Currently the golangci-lint version passed to golangci-lint-action.
